method: Independent capability requirements from public official documentation; no proprietary binary inspection or implementation code was used.
status_policy: All entries begin planned. A status change requires implementation evidence; feature parity additionally requires acceptance and comparison evidence.
coverage_note: 144 grouped capability requirements cover documented product areas. They are not a reproduction or verified inventory of every individual issue filter. Full parity is NOT PROVEN.

project_constraints.implementation: Independent Rust implementation preferred by user
project_constraints.operation: Local operation; container/WSL/native launch packaging can be selected separately
project_constraints.url_limit: No commercial URL cap; user-configurable resource limits and physical hardware limits remain
project_constraints.third_party_services: Separate authorization, accounts, quotas and fees may be required; no credential or license bypass
project_constraints.compatibility: Open SEO Spider snapshot/config formats first. Compatibility with proprietary crawl files is not claimed.

phases.P1: HTTP crawler foundation and essential extraction
phases.P2: Persistence, graph analysis, relationships, sitemaps and analyst interface
phases.P3: Browser rendering, extraction and advanced validation
phases.P4: Authorized providers, optional AI, automation and MCP

features.name: Website spider
features.acceptance_test: Crawl a synthetic linked graph; fetch each normalized URL once and preserve every link occurrence.

features.name: List import
features.acceptance_test: Import TXT, CSV, XLSX and XML; keep original row order and duplicate inputs in exports while deduplicating network work.

features.name: Offline SERP editing
features.acceptance_test: Import URL/title/description rows, calculate length and approximate width, and export without making network requests.

features.name: API-only enrichment
features.acceptance_test: Enrich supplied URLs using a mock API; record zero website requests.

features.name: Snapshot comparison
features.acceptance_test: Compare two saved fixture snapshots and classify new, missing and changed URLs.

features.name: Pause, stop, resume
features.acceptance_test: Pause with requests in flight, persist frontier, restart, and complete with no missing or duplicated results.

features.name: Selective re-crawl
features.acceptance_test: Re-fetch a chosen failed URL after the fixture changes without clearing unrelated saved results.

features.name: No commercial URL ceiling
features.acceptance_test: Complete a deterministic 501-URL fixture; configurable operator limits remain independent of licenses.

features.name: Host, subdomain and folder scope
features.acceptance_test: Verify exact host, all-subdomains and start-folder policies against an HTTP fixture with cross-scope links.

features.name: Per-type discovery and storage
features.acceptance_test: Independently store and fetch HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, media, PDF and legacy SWF references.

features.name: Relationship discovery
features.acceptance_test: Enable discovery separately for canonicals, hreflang, next/prev, AMP, iframe, mobile alternate and meta refresh.

features.name: URL identity and encoding
features.acceptance_test: Cover relative URLs, base href, Unicode host/path, percent encoding, fragments and duplicate query strings without merging distinct resources.

features.name: URL rewriting rules
features.acceptance_test: Apply saved query removal, regex replacement and rewrite rules; keep original and requested addresses for evidence.

features.name: Include/exclude expressions
features.acceptance_test: Exercise allow and deny regexes against links and resources with an explained exclusion reason.

features.name: CDN classification
features.acceptance_test: Classify configured CDN hosts as internal while preventing unrestricted external traversal.

features.name: Link directive policy
features.acceptance_test: Exercise nofollow, ugc, sponsored and page nofollow; store links regardless of whether discovery is enabled.

features.name: Operator crawl controls
features.acceptance_test: Test total, depth, URLs-per-depth, folder, query, subdomain, redirect, URL length, link-count and response-size bounds.

features.name: Concurrency and request speed
features.acceptance_test: Use a timestamped fixture to prove request-rate bounds and bounded concurrency under latency.

features.name: Timeout and retry policy
features.acceptance_test: Distinguish timeout, DNS/network and HTTP errors; retry selected 5xx responses with bounded attempts.

features.name: Agents, headers and proxies
features.acceptance_test: Verify custom user agent/header and proxy behavior using captured fixture requests; redact secrets from export.

features.name: Trusted certificates and HSTS
features.acceptance_test: Crawl a fixture with a user-trusted certificate and observe HSTS upgrade provenance without disabling validation globally.

features.name: robots.txt retrieval and caching
features.acceptance_test: Cache per origin and test distinct policy on scheme/host/port; record blocked URLs without fabricated status codes.

features.name: Agent matching and directives
features.acceptance_test: Run fixtures for multiple user-agent groups, allow/disallow wildcards, end anchors and sitemap declarations.

features.name: Custom policy simulation
features.acceptance_test: Evaluate supplied rules against a URL list without editing the remote site's robots.txt.

features.name: Explicit robots override
features.acceptance_test: Keep respect as the default; require a saved explicit override and show its state in crawl metadata.

features.name: Meta and HTTP robots
features.acceptance_test: Extract multiple meta robots and X-Robots-Tag fields; distinguish general and agent-specific directives.

features.name: Indexability explanations
features.acceptance_test: Report concrete reasons for redirect, robots blocking, noindex, non-HTML and canonicalization with supporting evidence.

features.name: Directive-dependent discovery
features.acceptance_test: Verify saved noindex/canonical/pagination policies influence expansion without suppressing observed evidence.

features.name: Response evidence
features.acceptance_test: Record status, final content type, measured bytes, transferred bytes, timings and complete header evidence.

features.name: Status and network failure groups
features.acceptance_test: Seed 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx, timeout and malformed links; expose distinct machine-readable results.

features.name: Redirect chains and loops
features.acceptance_test: Persist every hop including terminal URL; find chains, circular loops, off-scope destinations and non-200 endings.

features.name: Refresh and script redirects
features.acceptance_test: Detect HTTP refresh, meta refresh and rendered JavaScript navigation; label each mechanism separately.

features.name: Migration destination validation
features.acceptance_test: Check a CSV of old/new URL expectations and identify mismatched final destinations.

features.name: Broken-link source export
features.acceptance_test: Export every source occurrence for a broken destination with anchor, rel and location.

features.name: Title extraction and audits
features.acceptance_test: Test absent, empty, multiple, duplicate and configurable character/width thresholds with a known HTML fixture.

features.name: Description extraction and audits
features.acceptance_test: Test absent, duplicate, multiple and length/width limits without assuming a fixed search-engine display width.

features.name: H1/H2 and meta keyword evidence
features.acceptance_test: Record heading order and duplicate/missing/multiple conditions plus meta keyword values as observational fields.

features.name: SERP preview
features.acceptance_test: Show editable title/description preview; identify it as an approximation and export edited values.

features.name: Configurable content area
features.acceptance_test: Exclude shared navigation/footer and include a chosen selector; prove selected text feeds analysis.

features.name: Text count and ratio
features.acceptance_test: Use fixture paragraphs and hidden/script content to prove documented tokenization and text/code calculations.

features.name: Readability scoring
features.acceptance_test: Return score and formula/language version; classify unsupported language explicitly.

features.name: Exact duplicate detection
features.acceptance_test: Group identical content but separate a one-character change; record the digest method.

features.name: Near duplicate detection
features.acceptance_test: Score a controlled changed paragraph above/below a configured threshold; preserve matched URL and comparison evidence.

features.name: Spelling and grammar
features.acceptance_test: Test multilingual dictionaries, ignored words/rules and exact issue locations against saved text.

features.name: N-gram frequency
features.acceptance_test: Count overlapping one-, two- and three-word sequences with documented stopword and case policies.

features.name: Inlinks and outlinks
features.acceptance_test: For repeated A-to-B anchors, expose total occurrences and unique sources separately with anchor text and rel.

features.name: Link position and path
features.acceptance_test: Classify nav/header/footer/content links and custom positions; retain selector/path per occurrence.

features.name: Shortest crawl depth
features.acceptance_test: On a graph with multiple routes, compute minimum click depth deterministically after complete discovery.

features.name: Internal authority scoring
features.acceptance_test: Run a documented independent PageRank-style method on a known graph; save algorithm and parameter version.

features.name: Orphan URL discovery
features.acceptance_test: Merge sitemap/analytics/search data; distinguish absent internal links from incomplete crawl coverage.

features.name: Nonstandard link evidence
features.acceptance_test: Record onclick, javascript URLs and href on non-anchor elements without assuming a valid navigable target.

features.name: Bookmark validation
features.acceptance_test: Verify decoded fragment destinations against IDs/names; distinguish a missing fragment from a failed page.

features.name: Crawl tree and graph views
features.acceptance_test: Render shortest-path hierarchy, focus/expand and status/indexability coloring from fixture data.

features.name: Directory architecture views
features.acceptance_test: Build directory hierarchy including synthetic grouping paths and label paths that are not fetched URLs.

features.name: 3D graph views
features.acceptance_test: Display a bounded large graph and expose truncation/focus rather than silently omitting nodes.

features.name: Configurable segmentation
features.acceptance_test: Apply ordered field/regex segments and filter counts, issues, charts and exports by segment.

features.name: Canonical extraction
features.acceptance_test: Extract HTML and HTTP Link canonical entries including relative, multiple and self-referencing values.

features.name: Canonical validation
features.acceptance_test: Flag malformed, conflicting, redirecting, blocked and non-indexable targets and canonical chains.

features.name: Pagination relationship validation
features.acceptance_test: Extract HTML/HTTP next and prev; test broken links, absent returns and inconsistent chains.

features.name: Hreflang extraction
features.acceptance_test: Read HTML, HTTP Link and XML sitemap alternates with language/region and x-default.

features.name: Hreflang reciprocity and validity
features.acceptance_test: Test unsupported codes, missing returns/self-reference, duplicates and non-indexable targets.

features.name: AMP extraction and validation
features.acceptance_test: Detect amphtml/canonical reciprocity and report versioned AMP validation findings.

features.name: Mobile alternate relationships
features.acceptance_test: Resolve alternate media relationships and surface missing or non-indexable target evidence.

features.name: Image candidates and occurrences
features.acceptance_test: Record src/srcset candidates and every source page independently; preserve per-occurrence alt.

features.name: Missing alt distinctions
features.acceptance_test: Separate missing attribute from empty/whitespace alt using three deliberately different image elements.

features.name: Image dimensions and size audits
features.acceptance_test: Record intrinsic/rendered dimensions, transfer size and configurable thresholds without mislabeling unavailable data.

features.name: Cookie audit
features.acceptance_test: Collect response and script cookies with domain/path/security attributes and distinguish session contexts.

features.name: PDF metadata and text
features.acceptance_test: Extract title, author, dates, pages and text from an owned fixture PDF; show unsupported encrypted files explicitly.

features.name: PDF links and anchor evidence
features.acceptance_test: Resolve link annotations, record source document/page and extract text where reliable.

features.name: Raw HTML mode
features.acceptance_test: Fetch and parse a script-dependent fixture while proving no JavaScript execution.

features.name: Chromium rendering mode
features.acceptance_test: Discover links created after script execution; save browser/version/config used for the crawl.

features.name: Render completion policy
features.acceptance_test: Control viewport, wait/timeout and resource loading; distinguish timed-out render from a successful raw fetch.

features.name: Raw/rendered parity analysis
features.acceptance_test: Surface elements and links added/removed by rendering while retaining both representations.

features.name: Rendered screenshots
features.acceptance_test: Capture a deterministic owned page at selected viewport and link the image to URL/snapshot.

features.name: Console and blocked-resource evidence
features.acceptance_test: Save browser JS errors and failed/robots-blocked resource loads with URLs and error types.

features.name: Shadow DOM and iframe flattening
features.acceptance_test: Extract owned fixtures with shadow roots and same-origin iframe content; preserve source context.

features.name: Website archiving
features.acceptance_test: Save configured page/resource artifacts and verify a manifest can locate each stored file.

features.name: CSS/XPath/regex extraction
features.acceptance_test: Return text, attributes, HTML, inner HTML and function values from a known fixture with multi-value results.

features.name: Visual selector authoring
features.acceptance_test: Choose an element, preview raw/rendered extraction, save selector and verify it on a second fixture.

features.name: Literal and regex search
features.acceptance_test: Search source, rendered content and selected text with occurrence counts and match evidence.

features.name: Custom JavaScript extraction
features.acceptance_test: Run a user-authored script against a fixture with timeout/error handling and typed returned columns.

features.name: Scripted interactions
features.acceptance_test: Execute authored hover/click/scroll actions in declared order and discover resulting links.

features.name: User snippet library
features.acceptance_test: Import/export user-owned snippets without storing provider secrets in shared library files.

features.name: JSON-LD, Microdata and RDFa
features.acceptance_test: Extract nested graphs from each format; keep parse errors and raw node references.

features.name: Schema vocabulary validation
features.acceptance_test: Check types/properties against an identified schema version; test unknown and deprecated terms.

features.name: Rich result requirements
features.acceptance_test: Validate required/recommended fields using versioned public rules; distinguish errors from warnings.

features.name: axe accessibility findings
features.acceptance_test: Run version-pinned axe on a deliberately failing rendered fixture; retain rule, impact, node and WCAG tags.

features.name: Manual accessibility boundaries
features.acceptance_test: Display automated-only coverage and incomplete/needs-review findings in report exports.

features.name: Mobile usability checks
features.acceptance_test: Test viewport, sizing, tap targets and incompatible content under defined mobile rendering.

features.name: Invalid head elements
features.acceptance_test: Seed invalid head children that affect subsequent metadata; point to observed raw markup.

features.name: HTML conformance checks
features.acceptance_test: Run a versioned validator against owned malformed HTML and retain line/column/rule where available.

features.name: Transport and header audits
features.acceptance_test: Test mixed content, insecure forms, MIME mismatch and configurable security-header presence with concrete evidence.

features.name: Green hosting and carbon estimate
features.acceptance_test: Expose dataset/method/version and unknown states; label output as an estimate.

features.name: Robots and explicit sitemaps
features.acceptance_test: Load a sitemap index, gzipped child sitemap and explicit input; handle loops/malformed XML safely.

features.name: Sitemap coverage and orphan checks
features.acceptance_test: Compare fetched pages and sitemap locations; distinguish not listed, sitemap-only and incomplete crawl.

features.name: Sitemap URL validation
features.acceptance_test: Find redirect/non-200/non-indexable URLs and invalid lastmod values in fixture XML.

features.name: XML sitemap generation
features.acceptance_test: Export valid XML with optional lastmod, image entries and hreflang; parse output with an independent parser.

features.name: Split and segmented sitemaps
features.acceptance_test: Split at configured URL/byte bounds, create index and prove segment URL membership.

features.name: Google Analytics 4
features.acceptance_test: Using an authorized property, join page metrics with declared URL matching and preserve absent data as absent.

features.name: Search Console analytics
features.acceptance_test: Fetch selected dates/dimensions and join clicks/impressions/CTR/position; report API errors and row coverage.

features.name: Search Console URL inspection
features.acceptance_test: Honor daily/property quotas; retain inspection timestamp and distinguish inspected from queued URLs.

features.name: PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse
features.acceptance_test: Preserve mobile/desktop, field/lab distinction, metric units and provider error details.

features.name: Core Web Vitals aggregation
features.acceptance_test: Compute pass/fail from available field metrics; never substitute lab results for unavailable field data.

features.name: Majestic metrics
features.acceptance_test: Use separately authorized credentials; mock fresh/historic datasets, quota exhaustion and URL/domain scopes.

features.name: Ahrefs metrics
features.acceptance_test: Use independent authorized app/API access; mock expiry, quota and metric joins without reusing vendor tokens.

features.name: Moz metrics
features.acceptance_test: Mock authorized URL/domain metric queries with unavailable/quota states.

features.name: Account connection management
features.acceptance_test: Add, disconnect and revoke an authorized provider account; verify tokens stay out of logs and version control.

features.name: API-discovered crawl candidates
features.acceptance_test: Optionally enqueue provider-only URLs with provenance and scope checking; preserve orphan evidence.

features.name: Cloud and local model adapters
features.acceptance_test: Use mock OpenAI-compatible/Gemini/Anthropic and a local Ollama endpoint; record model/provider errors separately.

features.name: Custom prompts and test preview
features.acceptance_test: Run an authored prompt on selected page text/HTML/extraction; preview exact input and persist typed output.

features.name: Prompt import/export
features.acceptance_test: Round-trip user-authored prompts with model/settings and no secrets.

features.name: Embedding generation
features.acceptance_test: Embed selected text, cache with model/input hash and reject incompatible dimensionality.

features.name: Semantic similarity
features.acceptance_test: Rank a known vector fixture using a documented cosine method and configured thresholds.

features.name: Semantic relevance and outliers
features.acceptance_test: Report low-centroid-similarity fixture vectors with exact scores and declared corpus coverage.

features.name: Semantic search and clusters
features.acceptance_test: Query saved vectors and visualize clusters while retaining model/dimensionality provenance.

features.name: Semantic redirect suggestions
features.acceptance_test: Rank candidate target pages from a deterministic vector fixture and export suggestions with score; never apply redirects automatically.

features.name: Provider cost and rate controls
features.acceptance_test: Enforce explicit rate/spend bounds for an API fixture, record retries and distinguish local from paid providers.

features.name: Durable local database
features.acceptance_test: Crash after committed requests; recover completed results and pending queue with consistent graph state.

features.name: Optional memory storage
features.acceptance_test: Run the same fixture in memory and disk modes; compare results while documenting mode differences.

features.name: Save/open/import/export snapshots
features.acceptance_test: Round-trip an Open SEO Spider snapshot including config, graph, issues and optional artifacts; verify schema version.

features.name: Projects and crawl history
features.acceptance_test: Group snapshots by project, label them, reopen them and record their creation/config identity.

features.name: Retention and locking
features.acceptance_test: Use test timestamps to expire unlocked fixture snapshots while preserving locked snapshots and active jobs.

features.name: Reusable crawl configuration
features.acceptance_test: Export/import typed config and validate missing credentials/paths without silently changing settings.

features.name: Shared crawl portability
features.acceptance_test: Copy an Open SEO Spider archive to a second local directory and open all declared portable artifacts.

features.name: Field and content changes
features.acceptance_test: Detect title, description, headings, graph, directives, structured data and content changes even if issue counts are unchanged.

features.name: Cross-host comparison mapping
features.acceptance_test: Map staging/production or migrated URL prefixes before joining snapshots and expose collisions.

features.name: Comparison export
features.acceptance_test: Export both snapshots and deltas with new/missing/changed evidence and stable URL keys.

features.name: Table and bulk exports
features.acceptance_test: Export filtered observations and all-occurrence evidence as CSV/XLSX; escape formulas and preserve Unicode/newlines.

features.name: Issue and specialist reports
features.acceptance_test: Export versioned overview plus redirect/canonical/hreflang/sitemap/security/content report fixtures.

features.name: Artifact exports
features.acceptance_test: Export source, rendered HTML, screenshots, headers, cookies and PDF artifacts with a manifest.

features.name: Google Sheets/Looker output
features.acceptance_test: Use an authorized export destination; retain append/replace setting and stable column schema across two runs.

features.name: Headless command line
features.acceptance_test: Run a crawl/config/import/analysis/export sequence from CLI and verify deterministic exit codes.

features.name: Recurring scheduling
features.acceptance_test: Use a fake clock to execute saved crawl tasks, record history/errors and define overlap policy.

features.name: Automatic last-two comparison
features.acceptance_test: After two completed project snapshots, create a comparison automatically using saved comparison settings.

features.name: Completion and change notifications
features.acceptance_test: Send only to an explicitly configured local test SMTP sink; verify summary, change table and attachment error handling.

features.name: MCP agent interface
features.acceptance_test: Perform MCP initialize/list-tools/crawl/read/export using a local client; keep script execution an explicit capability.

features.name: STDIO and streamable HTTP
features.acceptance_test: Exercise both transports on loopback and prove JSON protocol framing and job identifiers remain stable.

features.name: Local usage statistics
features.acceptance_test: Aggregate locally saved crawl counts/duration without sending telemetry by default.

features.name: Live crawl progress and tables
features.acceptance_test: During a delayed fixture crawl, update progress/results and permit safe pause/config inspection.

features.name: Sort, search and saved columns
features.acceptance_test: Combine numeric/text filters and sort; keep column preferences when reopening a project.

features.name: Overview and issue taxonomy
features.acceptance_test: Show severity/type/count and drill-down to every affected URL; distinguish observation from advice.

features.name: URL evidence inspector
features.acceptance_test: Select a URL and inspect links, resources, raw/rendered source, headers, cookies and structured nodes.

features.name: Site structure and timing charts
features.acceptance_test: Aggregate folder/depth/status/timing over a fixture dataset with consistent filtered totals.

features.name: Language and UI preferences
features.acceptance_test: Switch supported interface locale/theme/font settings while preserving stored crawl text exactly.
